summary: sign-out callback form races with session invalidation; switch to redirectUrl option
description:
Live: clicking the Sign out menuitem closes the dropdown (handleSignOut sets avatarOpen=false for instant feedback) but does not actually sign the user out. signOut(callback) → callback calls router.push('/') is racing with Clerk's async session-invalidation work; either the callback never fires or the router push happens while the cookie/session is still mid-flight.

Clerk's preferred modern pattern is signOut({ redirectUrl }) — Clerk does the invalidation, then triggers a full window.location redirect at the end. Bypasses the race entirely.

Done when:
- handleSignOut calls signOut({ redirectUrl: '/' }) instead of signOut(callback)
- existing source-level test still passes (signOut() is still called)
- live: clicking Sign out actually signs out and lands on /
